Core 22.01 puts a model in range of its own ability only for Aura abilities, and Dreadherder is not tagged Aura. So whether the Dakkarig can pick its own unit is open. The app (notSelf) says it cannot. Every other part is right: any Orks WALKER, the other Big Mek Dakkarig included; all attacks; until the end of the turn.

Both sentences are true: "Re-roll advance rolls", and a unit riled up when selected to advance stays eligible to declare a charge.
"That unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]": true.

The rule is "When that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent…": the unit must be riled up when it advances. A unit riled up after advancing (Makari, Dread Power or Intimidating Motivation later in the phase) still cannot charge, but the reminder would let it.

fix.text: A unit that was riled up when it advanced can still declare a charge.

"if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase" is always true outside the Fight phase, so by the letter a destroyed WARBOSS stays (on 3+) until the end of any phase. "roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results)": the table's columns are "D6 | RESULT". "Duplicate results" can mean the same die value (then 1+2 gives +1 A twice, or once) or the same table result (then two D6 always give two different effects). why: The first and third sentences are true (the third is Wahapedia FAQ: "Fight on Death rules are resolved before Deadly Demise"). But "a datasheet name counts as a keyword" is not a rule. The real reason is that the Deff Dread datasheet itself lists the keyword (BSData categories: Vehicle, Walker, Deff Dread, Faction: Orks). Wahapedia's strike-through tooltip reads "Keyword does not appear in that faction."

fix.note: No unit in this list is a DEFF DREAD, so the roll is a plain 4+. (Wahapedia strikes DEFF DREAD through as a keyword no Orks datasheet has, but the Deff Dread datasheet does have the DEFF DREAD keyword in BSData, which New Recruit uses, so Deff Dreads get the +3.) Wahapedia FAQ: Fight on Death rules resolve before Deadly Demise, so Deadly Demise resolves once the models are removed.
